quick_facts.sprint_goal: Enable cashiers to apply discounts on line items, managers to process refunds, and support split cash+card payment — covering the most common real-world POS scenarios beyond the basic MVP flow.

content.tldr: Advanced POS features: line-item discounts, refund workflow (backend state completed→refunded already exists in state machine — now gets UI), and split payment (cash+card partial amounts).

features_committed.title: Line-Item Discounts
features_committed.rationale: Promotional pricing and on-the-spot discounts are expected by every retail customer.
tasks: T061: OrderItem entity: add discountPercent integer (0-100, default 0) + migration
T063: Recalculate subtotal = unitPriceVnd * qty * (1 - discount/100) — integer floor VNĐ
T064: Invoice VAT recalculated on discounted price
T065: POS UI: discount input per cart item (0-100%)
T066: Cart total shows original price strikethrough + discounted total

features_committed.title: Refund Workflow
features_committed.rationale: Backend state machine already supports 'refunded'. This sprint adds the UI and triggers invoice void.
tasks: T067: POST /orders/:id/refund — transitions completed → refunded (manager role only)
T068: On refund: invoice.status → cancelled (linked invoice voided)
T069: Order detail page: 'Hoàn tiền' button visible to manager role on completed orders
T070: Confirmation dialog: 'Xác nhận hoàn tiền? Hóa đơn sẽ bị huỷ.'
T071: Refunded order shown with strikethrough + red badge in orders list

features_committed.title: Split Payment (Cash + Card)
features_committed.rationale: Common in Vietnamese retail: customer pays partial cash, partial card.
tasks: T072: Order: add cashAmountVnd + cardAmountVnd fields (must sum to totalVnd) + migration
T074: POS payment modal: two amount fields + real-time validation that sum == cart total

out_of_scope: QR code payment (e.g., VNPay, Momo) — Sprint 10+
Partial refund (full refund only this sprint)
prerequisites: Sprint 3: Order state machine + Invoice auto-generation stable
Sprint 4: AppLayout + role-based nav in place

audit.author: vibe-project-manager
audit.note: Sprint 8 planned. Full-stack: discounts + refund UI + split payment. Backend+frontend together.
